chapters.title: News of Jerusalem's Ruin
chapters.synopsis: Nehemiah, cupbearer to king Artaxerxes in Susa, hears that Jerusalem's walls lie broken and its gates burned. He weeps, fasts, and prays for days, confessing Israel's sins and pleading God's covenant promises.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah hears of Jerusalem's ruined walls

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah's prayer of confession and petition

chapters.title: Nehemiah's Journey to Jerusalem
chapters.synopsis: Sad before the king, Nehemiah is granted leave and letters of safe passage to Jerusalem. He inspects the broken walls by night and calls the people to rise up and rebuild.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah requests leave to rebuild Jerusalem

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah surveys the broken walls by night

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah calls the people to rebuild

chapters.title: The Builders of the Wall
chapters.synopsis: Nehemiah catalogs the priests and families who each repair a section of the wall, many working near their own homes. The list shows the whole community united in a single labor.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Each family repairs its section of the wall

chapters.title: Opposition and Armed Builders
chapters.synopsis: Sanballat and Tobiah mock the builders and plot to attack Jerusalem. Nehemiah arms half the workers while the rest continue building, trusting the Lord to fight for them.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Enemies mock and plot against the builders

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Builders work with a weapon in hand

chapters.title: Nehemiah Confronts Oppression
chapters.synopsis: Poorer Jews cry out against nobles charging usury and taking their children as pledges for debt. Nehemiah rebukes the nobles publicly, cancels the debts, and models generosity as governor.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The poor cry out against usury and debt

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah rebukes the nobles for oppression

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah's generosity as governor

chapters.title: The Wall Finished in 52 Days
chapters.synopsis: Enemies try to lure Nehemiah into a trap and spread false rumors of rebellion, but he refuses to be intimidated. The wall is completed in fifty-two days, to the enemies' dismay.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Enemies try to lure and intimidate Nehemiah

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The wall is finished in fifty-two days

chapters.title: Register of the Returned Exiles
chapters.synopsis: Nehemiah appoints gatekeepers and singers to guard the city, then records the genealogical list of those who first returned from Babylon, matching the earlier register kept by Ezra.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Nehemiah appoints gatekeepers over the city

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The register of those who returned from exile

chapters.title: Ezra Reads the Law Aloud
chapters.synopsis: Ezra reads the book of the law before the assembled people at the Water Gate, and Levites help them understand it. The people weep, then rejoice and keep the Feast of Tabernacles as it is written.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra reads the law before the assembled people

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The people are told to rejoice, not weep

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The Feast of Tabernacles is kept as written

chapters.title: A Great Prayer of Confession
chapters.synopsis: The people fast, confess their sins, and separate themselves from foreigners. The Levites then lead all Israel in a sweeping prayer recounting the Lord's mighty acts and Israel's repeated apostasy and His enduring mercy.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: The people fast, confess, and separate themselves

segments.speaker: church
segments.note: Israel recounts God's mercies and their rebellions

chapters.title: The Covenant Sealed and Signed
chapters.synopsis: Leaders, priests, and Levites seal a written covenant to keep God's law, tithe faithfully, and support the temple. A long list of names records who signed the agreement.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Leaders and priests sign the sealed covenant

segments.speaker: church
segments.note: The people vow to keep the law and tithes

chapters.title: Settlers in Jerusalem and Judah
chapters.synopsis: Leaders cast lots to bring one in ten families to live inside Jerusalem while the rest remain in the towns. Nehemiah records those who settle in the city alongside the priests, Levites, and villages of Judah and Benjamin.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Settlers are chosen for Jerusalem and Judah's towns

chapters.title: Priests, Levites, and the Wall's Dedication
chapters.synopsis: Nehemiah records the priests and Levites of the returning generations, then leads two great choirs in procession around the finished wall. The city rejoices with singing, music, and thanksgiving offerings.

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Generations of priests and Levites recorded

segments.note: Two choirs process joyfully around the dedicated wall

segments.speaker: nehemiah
segments.note: Offerings and singers appointed in order

chapters.title: Nehemiah's Later Reforms
chapters.synopsis: Returning to Jerusalem after a time away, Nehemiah finds old abuses creeping back: Tobiah lodged in the temple, Levites unpaid, the Sabbath profaned, and mixed marriages again common. He forcefully corrects each one.

segments.note: Nehemiah expels Tobiah from the temple chamber

segments.note: Neglected Levites and tithes are restored

segments.note: Nehemiah enforces the sanctity of the Sabbath
